- Milton Friedman was an American economist.

- EdChoice was founded in 1996 by Milton Friedman and his wife, economist Rose Director Friedman.
- Jason Bedrick is the Director of Policy at EdChoice.
- Jason Bedrick is an adjunct scholar at the Cato Institute's Center for Educational Freedom.
- Jason Bedrick was previously a policy analyst at the Cato Institute's Center for Educational Freedom.
